review_type: Independent page-layout QA within a multi-agent workflow; not independent human screening, scientific peer review or formal risk-of-bias assessment.
scope: Rendered page appearance: typography, overlap, clipping, visible link formatting, missing characters, page breaks and short orphan pages.
limitations: Hyperlink destinations and click behavior were not tested by this visual inspection.
Scientific eligibility, statistical validity and metadata accuracy are not certified by this layout check.
Root reported that the corrected render changed only pages 9, 11 and 17; page 17 was re-inspected directly. Other assigned pages were visually inspected at original resolution.

resolved_issues.original_issue: Markdown emphasis consumed the two asterisks in drug*[tiab] OR medicat*[tiab], leaving an altered printed query.
resolved_issues.resolution: Root rendered the query as literal text; original-resolution re-inspection confirms all wildcard characters are present.

minor_issues.issue: Policy references render a leading period after the stable ID: [P-ID] . Title.
minor_issues.suggested_fix: Suppress the author separator when the author string is empty; do not invent organizational authors.
